registers.name: BITMAP_CTRL

fields.name: BPP
fields.description: Bitmap bits-per-pixel mode selector; 0b10 selects RGB565 direct color.

fields.name: CELL_WIDTH_LOG2
fields.description: Log2 cell width for indexed bitmap addressing.

registers.description: Enables SDRAM bitmap fetch and selects bitmap format.

registers.name: BITMAP_BASE_LO
registers.description: Low 16 bits of the SDRAM bitmap byte-plane base address. In RGB565 direct-color mode (BITMAP_CTRL mode 0b10) the effective base is forced 32-byte aligned by the hardware; writes to bits [4:0] are ignored in that mode.

registers.name: BITMAP_BASE_HI
registers.description: High 7 bits of the SDRAM bitmap byte-plane base address. Combined with BITMAP_BASE_LO to form a 23-bit byte address; the low 5 bits are masked to zero in RGB565 direct-color burst mode.

registers.name: ATTR_BASE_LO
registers.description: Low 16 bits of the SDRAM attribute or high-byte plane base address. In RGB565 direct-color mode the effective base is forced 32-byte aligned by the hardware; writes to bits [4:0] are ignored in that mode.

registers.name: ATTR_BASE_HI

fields.name: ADDR_HI
fields.description: Address bits 22:16 for attribute or high-byte plane base.

registers.description: High 7 bits of the SDRAM attribute or high-byte plane base address. Combined with ATTR_BASE_LO to form a 23-bit byte address; the low 5 bits are masked to zero in RGB565 direct-color burst mode.

registers.name: BITMAP_STRIDE
registers.description: Direct-color bitmap byte-plane row stride in bytes. In RGB565 direct-color mode the hardware masks bits [4:0] to zero, so the stride must be a multiple of 32 bytes. The default 0x0200 (512) is 32-byte aligned.

registers.name: ATTR_STRIDE
registers.description: Direct-color attribute or high-byte plane row stride in bytes. In RGB565 direct-color mode the hardware masks bits [4:0] to zero, so the stride must be a multiple of 32 bytes. The default 0x0200 (512) is 32-byte aligned.

registers.name: BITMAP_HEIGHT
registers.description: Source bitmap height in rows; currently consumed by init-fill path only.

registers.name: PLANAR_WIDTH
registers.description: 10-bit planar clip width in pixels (default 320).
